deadline.value: Civil Engineering takes fall (August) international applications by January 8.

fee_waiver.value: The civil engineering handbook says the application fee cannot be waived under any circumstances.
fee_waiver.quote: The university does not allow waiver of the application fee under any circumstances.

gre_general.value: International applicants need an 80th-percentile quantitative GRE; ABET-accredited civil engineering bachelor's graduates may be waived.
gre_general.quote: K-State CE’s minimum requirement for admission is 80th percentile rank on quantitative portion of the exam.

also.quote: Students who have got their bachelor’s degree from an ABET - accredited civil engineering program may be waived from the GRE requirement

toefl_min.value: The civil engineering handbook (version 8/21) sets 79 on the internet-based TOEFL; the Graduate School's current rule is 4.5 for tests from January 21, 2026.
toefl_min.quote: K-State CE’s minimum requirement for TOEFL is 550 paper-based / 213 computer-based / 79 internet-based.

entry_route.value: The primary admission requirement is a bachelor's degree from an ABET-accredited civil engineering program.
entry_route.quote: The primary requirement for admission to the civil engineering graduate program is the receipt of a bachelor of science degree from a civil engineering undergraduate program that is accredited by the Accreditation Board of Engineering and Technology (ABET)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The pages fetched do not say whether a supervisor's agreement is needed.

funding.value: The pages fetched do not state a funding rule.

notes: Civil handbook is dated 8/21, so its fee, GRE and TOEFL rules may be older than the Graduate School's; they are used because the department rule wins. Check with the department.
